meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
Achievement of Tenure – Definition (MN Statute §122A.41): In the State of Minnesota, tenure is defined as continued service after the completion of three consecutive years of successful teaching.
Following the presentation, the Achievement of Tenure Review Team (pursuant to the Teacher Tenure Act MN Statute §122A.41) will provide notice to the teacher either of completion of Achievement of Tenure or of work yet to be completed by the teacher.
